name: skyrim-vr-automation
description: Codex skills for transactional Skyrim VR automation, DevBench profiling, and shader-cache analysis.

interface.shortDescription: Safe Skyrim VR test and profiling controls.
interface.longDescription: Adds safety-bounded workflows for exact-profile Mod Organizer 2 sessions, transactional profile and shader-cache edits, backed-up SteamVR null-HMD switching, identity-bound DevBench calls, profiler captures, and bounded process retries.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my configured MO2 environment safely.
Switch SteamVR to null HMD with a recoverable backup.
Run a bounded Skyrim VR test session through MO2.
Capture and compare CSX profiler evidence.
Compare or transactionally restore compiled shader caches.
